remarks: Welcome to a perfect blend of comfort and convenience in this Glenbrook 1-bedroom rental with hardwood floors throughout and heat and hot water included. Step inside and discover a bright, open concept living room/kitchen with brand new cabinets and quartz countertops, spacious bedroom with double closet and a large bathroom. With plenty of closet space, an additional, private storage cage, on-site laundry & reserved parking, life is a breeze. Enjoy a walkable lifestyle and stress-free commuting - walk to the Glenbrook Train Station (just 6 minutes away) as well as nearby restaurants, shops and entertainment; also convenient to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. Don't miss out on this opportunity! Schedule your viewing today!
